cohort_contract.denominators: primary_role_book_offer_incidences is primary-role scope; all_role_outcome_states_book_incidences spans ALL roles and counts repeated book offers; do not divide those different populations
cohort_contract.dependence: 34,759 player-game-target query rows and92,445 book-threshold incidences are not independent NFL games; different targets/books can share players/games
cohort_contract.point: same primary-role common cohort forF/FC/M/H/offeredline; one offering book per player-game-category using fixed book priority
cohort_contract.probability: same decisive common cohort forF/FC/FS/M/H; choose book before removing pushes
cohort_contract.roles: original primary roles unchanged; all-role secondary forecasts/coverage are separate and are not primary RB gains for QB props

method_contract.F: authenticated retained leaf-CDF; counts use law mean/MSE, yards lower median/MAE; 2026 uses frozen2024model trained2019–2023
method_contract.FC: football-only earlier calibration: nonnegative-slope L2 empirical point correction; count outputs clamped at zero, signed-yard intercept unbounded; conditional-probability logistic calibration
method_contract.FS: separate probability confidence shrink toward0.5, estimated only from2022/2023 available development offers
method_contract.H: same fixed calibration learner asFC with independentM input added; not a new raw-feature CDF fit
method_contract.M: offering-book-excluded actual named-book point-line heuristic or proportional no-vig decisive probability; no inferred push law
method_contract.OFFERED_LINE_HEURISTIC: actual offering-book line scored as a point only; neither a latent-law mean nor a median claim

privacy: Only category/season aggregate metrics and non-sensitive verification metadata. No raw quote, player/game record, fitted coefficient, model weight, parameter table or private CSV.

timing_and_scope.2026_model_age: fixed2024CDF trained2019–2023; missing2024training may weaken this control; no best current or forever forecaster claim
timing_and_scope.ATD: rush/receive event only; no genuine No quote, so no fairM/H market comparison; zeroTD is loss, neverpush
timing_and_scope.GAP_SCREENED: laboratory F point-gap proxy screened using genuine F probability/price; not recorded website TopOver/Under
timing_and_scope.PPR: exact label contract and supplied source market absent; unsupported, not zero or a winner
timing_and_scope.calibration: available2022/2023 only; supplied2022 has no qualifying named-book pairs, so market calibration effectively uses2023; no2024/2026 tuning
timing_and_scope.deployment: no new live model, website feed, scheduler, promotion or scientific qualification
timing_and_scope.historical_SITE_R0_comparator: UNAVAILABLE: no claimed current-website or historical TopOver/Under win
timing_and_scope.lane: timing-unverified exploratory; current-vintage football reconstruction with original explicit seven-day availability assumption
timing_and_scope.paper: frozen choices retained; separate zero-fit paper accounting pending; actual book settlement UNQUALIFIED; no ROI/profitability claim

uncertainty_limits: Stored95% paired game/week intervals are nominal exposed-sample bootstrap intervals,500replicates,seed1703,min8clusters; no multiplicity-adjusted qualification
2026 has five weeks: whole-week intervals N_A under the existingmin8routine; this is not a new live-release prerequisite
Only H-versus-F paired intervals are reported here; H-versus-FC/M signed differences have no saved paired interval
2026 passing-yards probability common cohort is only12player-games
Registered error-threshold and bias diagnostics are retained; p90/p95/max error percentiles were not computed in this first-wave aggregate output

verification_references.projection: new aggregate-only allowlist projection; zero fits, models, inference, grading, policy selection or source requests
